location_description:
North Barrington is a village in Lake County, Illinois, United States. Per the 2020 census, the population was 3,171.


== Geography ==
According to the 2010 census, North Barrington has a total area of 4.896 square miles (12.68 km2), of which 4.64 square miles (12.02 km2) (or 94.77%) is land and 0.256 square miles (0.66 km2) (or 5.23%) is water.
